reviews.author: Victor L.

reviews.title: Price to Performance
reviews.comment:
Before the end of year ram shortage, this kit of ram was an easy recommendation from me. At under $90, it offered good speeds, latency, and all around performance.
I had purchased the 6400 kit and after my 9800X3D was having issues with it, lowered the speed to 6000 and used tighter timings which was ultimately faster.
Overall a good kit of memory but for the current prices of over $300 that’s a tough call to make.
reviews.author: Alex

reviews.title: Perfectly adequate
reviews.comment: Well you won't get the bump in FPS that RGB provides, but it is still a perfectly adequate kit. I ran it at 6000M/T and adjusted the timing as per the EXPO profile. So far no issue. Runs great with my Ryzen system at 1:1 with the memory controller.
reviews.author: Axel Roman

reviews.title: A RAM memory kit that makes a difference
reviews.comment:
I took my time before writing this review because I wanted to thoroughly test the product and make sure it performed well. I purchased this 32GB (2x16GB, 6400 MT/s) Crucial Pro DDR5 RAM kit, and I must say that I am very satisfied.
The modules look to be of excellent quality, and installation was very easy. After several months of intensive use, I can confirm that they work wonderfully: PC performance has improved significantly, multitasking is much smoother, and I haven't had a single compatibility or stability issue.
In short, this product is 100% recommended for those looking for speed and reliability in their equipment. Crucial continues to prove why it is a trusted brand.
reviews.author: Gaby López

reviews.title: Bargain priced at the time of purchase
reviews.comment: Crucial delivers quality products and these RAM modules were no exception. Easy installation, registered quickly on boot up and overclocking was really simple with no issues (5 months of use so far). Highly recommend this RAM for boards that have these listed for use.
